prompts.props: Premium cohesive cinematic 2.5D pixel-art assets for the ecological adventure THE GREAT LITTLE WORLD. High detail handcrafted pixel clusters, sophisticated warm sunlight from upper left, deep teal occlusion shadows, restrained highlights, rich believable materials. Same polished visual family as detailed emerald grass with dewdrops, not simple geometric pixel icons. Orthographic three-quarter RPG camera looking down roughly 30 degrees. Crisp readable contours, no soft illustration blur. Strictly transparent background with genuine alpha, no colored matte, no scenery, no ground plane, no baked cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Every subject fully inside its own cell, transparent gutters, constant physical size and locked pose origin across animation frames. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment SPRITE ATLAS. EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 isolated props. Same visual family as the lush dew-covered grass and detailed naturalistic insect sprites previously made. No scenery. Row 1: col1 mossy rounded grey river boulder with layered natural rock and little clover, col2 single brown-gold fallen leaf lying flat seen from above with curled edges, col3 horizontal forked weathered twig, col4 large clear tear-shaped dew droplet with a bright white specular highlight and dark teal refracted interior. Row2: col1 discarded transparent plastic water bottle lying diagonally with crumpled walls and NO printed label, col2 crumpled pale translucent blue food wrapper with no logos or writing, col3 discarded blue plastic bottle cap shown at low angle, col4 lush young green seedling with three leaves and visible tiny roots, isolated with no soil chunk. Row3: col1 tightly folded green butterfly chrysalis hanging from tiny brown stem, col2 short bridge of interwoven sticks shown from above at a shallow angle, col3 irregular cluster of tiny pale ant food crumbs and seeds, col4 horizontal mossy hollow root with dark opening. Genuine transparent alpha. Crisp readable silhouettes. Uniform detail level, no soft painting, no strong baked shadows. Leave clean transparent gutters.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repeatable diffuse GROUND TEXTURE ATLAS for a premium 2.5D pixel-art adventure. EXACT 2 by 2 square tiles in one 1024x1024 image, no borders no gaps no text. Each quadrant is a completely filled seamless repeating ground texture seen exactly from overhead, with no perspective horizon, no standalone objects or vignettes. Handcrafted high-detail pixel clusters, calm subtle contrast, small flecks and rich organic granularity, muted natural palette. Top-left: deep emerald moss and shaded fine garden earth, sparse tiny rounded gravel, forest floor WITHOUT leaves or vegetation silhouettes. Top-right: warm ochre-brown moist clay and loam inside an ant nest, scattered tiny quartz sand grains and compact granular ridges, NOT a cracked desert, NO ants or rooms or objects. Bottom-left: subdued blue-teal silt in a freshwater pond, softly patterned sand and tiny pebbles, NO water surface or ripples or bubbles. Bottom-right: deep cool brown decomposing leaf humus with fine dark mycelium threads, tiny pale granules, no glowing objects. Ground is quiet and readable under characters, never looks like slabs, bricks, carpet, checkerboard or circular cobblestones. No paths. Consistent small pixel size and similar surface scale across all quadrants. Low relief ambient shading with no strong directional light. Fully opaque.
